name: [🎃PART 2] Hallow's Eve 2023
desc:
Hallow's Eve 2026: Distorted Memory 👻

[EVENT🎃]: Discover a place that seems familiar, but feels different. As the hallows night approaches, look out for awards that await.

Hallow's Eve 2023 is currently now legacy and not updated or supported. We will still fix bugs from time to time, but that is all.

Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Hallow's Eve 2023 and embark on an adventure to uncover the mysteries of Hallowsland.

Choose your path on this spooky night – go trick-or-treating in captivating costumes or take on thrilling quests alongside talking pigs. Conquer the intricate corn maze to prove your navigational abilities, put your parkour skills to the test within the treacherous Skull Cave, or experience an eerie boat ride!

🎁 And don't forget to keep an eye out for exclusive items you can add to your collection! (All of our free UGC rewards have  been sold out.)

💜 Made with passion from @SpookedEthan, @FuntMaster, @DevMaximun, @BIULDERBRO, @5ouIs, and @TimeReset.
